body:
## Pull request overview

This PR adds comprehensive documentation for the `@object-ui/plugin-aggrid` plugin with 7 interactive demos showcasing AG Grid integration. It also implements a CSS loading solution for Next.js by moving AG Grid CSS imports from the lazy-loaded component to the entry point and exporting them via package.json.

**Changes:**
- Created complete documentation with interactive demos for the AG Grid plugin
- Implemented CSS bundling fix by moving imports from lazy component to entry point
- Integrated the plugin into the documentation site with proper navigation and dependencies

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-aggrid.mdx | New comprehensive documentation with 7 interactive demos showcasing AG Grid features including themes, pagination, row selection, and advanced configurations |
| content/docs/plugins/meta.json | Added plugin-aggrid to navigation in alphabetical order |
| apps/site/package.json | Added @object-ui/plugin-aggrid as workspace dependency |
| apps/site/app/layout.tsx | Imported AG Grid CSS globally in root layout for Next.js |
| apps/site/app/components/InteractiveDemo.tsx | Added plugin-aggrid to the list of lazy-loaded plugins |
| packages/plugin-aggrid/src/index.tsx | Moved AG Grid CSS imports from lazy component to entry point to fix Vite bundling issue |
| packages/plugin-aggrid/src/AgGridImpl.tsx | Removed CSS imports (now handled in entry point) |
| packages/plugin-aggrid/package.json | Added style.css export to make bundled CSS importable |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Updated lock file with new dependency |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

The Schema API documentation marks `rowData` and `columnDefs` as required with the comment "Grid data (required)" and "Column definitions (required)", but the TypeScript interface `AgGridSchema` in `packages/plugin-aggrid/src/types.ts` defines these as optional properties (`rowData?: any[]` and `columnDefs?: ColDef[]`). This creates a discrepancy between the documentation and the actual type definitions. Either update the types to make these required if they truly are, or remove the "(required)" comments from the documentation.
```suggestion
  rowData?: any[],                              // Grid data
  columnDefs?: ColDef[],                        // Column definitions
```

The package.json is missing the `sideEffects` field. Since this package imports CSS files at the entry point (lines 15-19 in index.tsx), it has side effects and should declare `"sideEffects": true` to prevent tree-shaking optimizations from removing these imports. This follows the pattern used in @object-ui/components (packages/components/package.json:19).
```suggestion
  },
  "sideEffects": true,
```

The PR description states "Successfully added comprehensive documentation for the `@object-ui/plugin-aggrid` plugin with 8 interactive demos" and mentions "All 7 interactive demos now render", but the actual documentation file contains exactly 7 interactive demo examples (Basic Data Grid, Pagination Enabled, Alpine Theme, Balham Theme, Material Theme, Row Selection, and Advanced Features). The description should be corrected to consistently state 7 demos, not 8.

The documentation is missing a critical setup step for Next.js applications. When using this plugin with Next.js (or any SSR framework), users need to import the CSS in their root layout as shown in `apps/site/app/layout.tsx:3`. Add a note in the Installation or Usage section explaining that Next.js users should add `import '@object-ui/plugin-aggrid/style.css';` to their root layout file. Without this, the AG Grid styles won't load properly.
